overview: The developer lists 1,132 homes and markets studios, one- to three-bedroom apartments and larger Sky Villas. Its public materials promote Aston Martin/Formitalia furnishings; the selected furnishing specification needs contractual confirmation.
Danube’s internal inspection dated 30 September 2026 reports 57% overall progress. This is a dated developer update, not independent regulatory certification or proof of handover.
research.locationNote: Jumeirah Lake Towers, Dubai, as identified in the project brochure and developer’s JLT section. A conflicting Dubai Marina label on the same webpage is not used as the project’s community.
research.priceNote: The developer FAQ and Property Finder retain AED 950,000, while the developer hero says SOLD OUT. This is a historical starting reference, not current inventory or a selected-unit offer.
research.paymentNote: The developer hero displays 30/70 without milestone dates, while its FAQ retains 1% monthly. Property Finder’s older schedule is 10% booking, 53% construction, 1% at handover and 36% after handover. These references are not interchangeable; obtain the selected unit’s current signed schedule and fees.
research.handoverNote: The developer hero states 2027 but its FAQ and Property Finder retain Q2/June 2026. A developer inspection dated 30 September 2026 still reports construction progress. No completed handover or contractual date is established.

unresolved: Sky Villa totals are transcribed from the paired lower/upper-floor unit drawings and are not doubled. Balcony totals are not enclosed living space. Other variants require their own plans.
Current unit availability, furniture schedule, service/cooling charges, parking, title terms, dated commercial milestones and contractual handover remain unverified.
Private pools, lift, storage and maid’s rooms depend on the selected Sky Villa/layout; shared facilities and brand references do not prove universal entitlement or operation.
